name: JoinPartyHorde
description: Make NPC(s) join the player's party as Horde followers.
note: Needs Horde and Mantella - Horde Followers. Use this instead of Mantella's Follow action; enable only one of the two.

source.description: The NPC(s) willing to join the party.

prompt: If the player asks you to follow them, travel with them or join their party, and you are thoroughly convinced to do so, begin your response with '{key}:'
